title: Ludic language
description: Finnic language of southern Karelia, Russia
extract: Ludic, Ludian, or Ludic Karelian, is a Finnic language in the Uralic language family or a third supradialect of Karelian. It is transitional between the Olonets Karelian language and the Veps language. It is spoken by 300 Karelians in the Republic of Karelia in Russia, near the southwestern shore of Lake Onega, including a few children.
